candidates.title: STB signals broader protection for rail-served projects against state and local restrictions
candidates.excerpt: The Surface Transportation Board is signaling that state and local restrictions on rail customers’ facilities may face greater scrutiny under federal law, issuing a sweeping policy statement that questions aspects of earlier agency decisions involving privately owned terminals and other rail-served projects. The statement, which becomes final Nov. 9, also lays out arguments for treating government or private efforts to take exclusive possession of railroad rights-of-way as categorically preempted — potentially avoiding a detailed inquiry into how each taking would affect train operations. The document essentially serves as a consolidation of existing law, and suggests potentially stronger federal protection for rail infrastructure and access to freight service, while stopping short of binding decisions or a blanket exemption from state and local oversight. “The Board is not making any binding determinations in this policy statement,” the agency says. candidates.title: UP No. 5511 begins steam testing
candidates.excerpt: SILVIS, Ill. — Union Pacific 2-10-2 No. 5511 was steamed up today (Friday, Nov. 6) by Railroading Heritage of Midwest America. It is the first time the locomotive has been under steam since 1956. The locomotive, built by Baldwin in 1923, is the sole remaining UP 2-10-2. RRHMA began an extensive rebuilding project after the engine was donated by UP in 2022. The locomotive was retired in 1956, and was last used that year as a stationary boiler for an industry in Ogden, Utah. It was used in filming the Union Pacific motion picture “Last of the Giants” in 1958, but was not under steam at that time. It was then stored in Green River, Wyo., until it was transferred to the UP roundhouse in Cheyenne, Wyo., in 1968. The locomotive, which underwent a hydrostatic test on Sept. 8, was pulled outside the Silvis facility and steamed up for testing. RRHMA has not announced any immediate plans to operate the 2-10-2. — To report news or errors, contact trainsnewswire@firecrown.com.
